function stand(){if(phase!=='player')return;phase='dealer';render();setMessage('Dealer plays');const dealerTurn=()=>{render();if(score(dealer)<17){dealer.push(deck.pop());setTimeout(dealerTurn,520)}else{const p=score(player),d=score(dealer);if(d>21)finish('Dealer bust — you win','win');else if(p>d)finish(player.length===2&&p===21?'Blackjack — you win':'You win',player.length===2&&p===21?'blackjack':'win');else if(p<d)finish('Dealer wins','loss');else finish('Push','push')}};setTimeout(dealerTurn,450)}
function finish(message,result){phase='over';if(result==='win')bankroll+=bet*2;else if(result==='blackjack')bankroll+=bet+Math.round(bet*1.5);else if(result==='push')bankroll+=bet;setMessage(message);bet=0;render();setTimeout(()=>{if(bankroll<=0){bankroll=1000;bet=0;setMessage('New bankroll — place your bet')}else setMessage('Place your next bet');phase='betting';render()},1600)}
